items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Joe Ball, do you know Joe Ball? Joe Barnes. Oh, Joe Barnes? Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] What did he play?

ctx.x: It's tough for that no man, call me Wiggles. Yeah. Yeah. It's coming?

Uh-huh. Yeah. I found out in the Chicago Defender, on January the 19th, 1935, they had Fats Pichon's band in Memphis, at the old plantation nightclub. You remember that? Yeah. That joint up there? Yeah. They got Raymond Brown? Yeah. Joe Ball, do you know Joe Ball? Joe Barnes. Oh, Joe Barnes? Yeah.
